title: Batch Sequence block is now a hard gate for all teachings — 16/28 retroactively fixed
signal: 16 of 28 teachings in hub/teachings_repo/framework/current/ were missing Batch Sequence blocks. Without them, spokes receiving a backlog of teachings have no way to determine safe apply order, risking dependency violations. All 16 retroactively fixed. wai-closeout.md Step 9b now enforces Prerequisites + Batch Sequence as a hard gate: 'Missing either block = teaching is incomplete. Fix before publishing.' All teachings now have explicit batch, apply order, depends-on, required-before, and parallel-safe fields.
rationale: Backlog accumulates when spokes are offline. When they reconnect, they need machine-readable ordering to avoid applying teachings in the wrong sequence. The spec said to include these blocks but didn't enforce it — 57% were missing them.
